answer: Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tundra re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
